newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs steady in London after results.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs steady in London after results.

text.p: Shares in biotech group Cortecs International Plc ended little changed in London trading on Monday after the group published full-year results, with disappointment over sales of a pioneeering diagnostic kit offsetting encouraging news on a new oral insulin product.
Shares in the company, which is listed on the London, Australian and NASDAQ stock exchanges, ended up just three pence at 310p, well below an intra-day peak of 326 pence.
In Australia on Monday, the shares had added 25 cents to A$6.60 as investors latched on to positive early results for the potentially ground-breaking diabetes drug.
